meta.note: Turbine brand (locked, D-034) plus the Studio UI language (chosen direction, D-036; concept, not final until Codex review). Source: planning/design/concepts/studio and the §22 pack.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Studio page ground, always with the dot grid. Ink on canvas 17.0:1; muted 5.3:1; quiet 3.8:1 (large text only).

tokens.name: canvas-2
tokens.usage: Sunk surfaces on canvas: progress tracks, unavailable slots, tab wells. Muted on canvas-2 4.9:1.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: The 24px dot grid on canvas. Decorative only.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, keys, inputs, receipts and the cards inside phone screens. Ink on surface 19.2:1; muted 6.0:1.

tokens.name: frost
tokens.usage: Frosted layers over canvas or imagery: nav, sheets, phone shell, dashboard. Always with blur-frost; text on it is checked against canvas.

tokens.name: hair
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and dividers between list rows. Decorative, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dashed receipt rules; chip and secondary-button outlines on surface (a decorative edge: the label carries the meaning).

tokens.name: control-edge
tokens.usage: Text-input and checkbox outlines on surface (3.2:1, meets the 3:1 control floor).

tokens.name: key-side
tokens.usage: The pressed-down side of a key-cap (its 3D edge).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body text, primary buttons, focus ring and the mark on light grounds. White on ink 19.2:1.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Secondary dark surface; strong secondary text on canvas (15.4:1). White on graphite 16.2:1.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Body copy, captions and metadata on canvas (5.3:1), surface (6.0:1), sky (5.0:1) and canvas-2 (4.9:1).

tokens.name: quiet
tokens.usage: Grey second line of display headlines only, 24px and up (3.8:1 on canvas). Never small text.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Brand motion glow, housing and pressure rings; secondary strokes in illustrations. Never text.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Confirmation ticks, progress fills, gradient accents. White on blue 4.3:1: icons and large text only.

tokens.name: blue-ink
tokens.usage: Blue text and info icons: on sky 5.3:1, on surface 6.3:1.

tokens.name: blue-soft
tokens.usage: Cool end of gradients and illustration fills.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Info label and note ground; quote-version chips; illustration fills.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Things counting down: the hold ring, live dots, the 360x640 fold line. App accent only; never part of the mark; never text below 24px (3.2:1 on canvas). Ink on signal 5.4:1.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Brand: signal on dark grounds at display sizes.

tokens.name: apricot
tokens.usage: Warm end of gradients (timeline rail, KPI bars, dashboard glow).

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Warm tint: the fee KPI card, the CarworX actor chip, fine slips.

tokens.name: peach-ink
tokens.usage: Text on peach (7.1:1), e.g. the CarworX actor chip.

tokens.name: note
tokens.usage: Sticky-note paper. Ink on note 16.0:1.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done and paid: label text and icons on ok-bg (5.7:1). Always with a word or an icon.

tokens.name: ok-bg
tokens.usage: Ground for done and paid labels and notes.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Waiting and expiring: label text and icons on warn-bg (5.8:1). Always with a word or an icon.

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Ground for waiting and expiring labels and notes.

tokens.name: err
tokens.usage: Problem and failed: label text and icons on err-bg (6.6:1). Always with a word or an icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: err-bg
tokens.usage: Ground for problem and failed labels and notes.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Brand: warm off-white ground for logo tiles and print. Ink on paper 16.8:1.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Brand: blades and wordmark on ink or graphite; text on ink buttons.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Brand: one-colour print, receipt printers, stamps and vinyl.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One hero headline per page; second line in quiet. Scales down to 40px on phones.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section headlines; second line in quiet. 34px on phones.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles and phone screen titles (21px in the app).

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: Large thin dashboard numbers; the currency prefix at 42% size.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Washes, repairs, glass and tyres from businesses near you.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a headline, in muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The business has two business hours to accept.
styles.usage: Running text on canvas and surface.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: You pay only after they accept.
styles.usage: Card text and phone body copy (13.5 to 15px in the app).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, key-cap labels and nav links (14px in the nav).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and fine print, in muted. Never below 12px.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section eyebrows and state headers, in muted.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Sticky notes only. Never for UI text or anything a person must act on.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps inside chips and labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The base step: gaps between chips, list rows and button groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between key-caps on phones; padding of compact cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the page side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gaps between groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a headline and its content.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Outer padding of logo tiles and the cover.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space above a row of keys or a screen group.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space between sub-sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding (fluid 80 to 144px on the page).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Sticky-note and receipt corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small cards and thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Notes, list cards, cards inside phones, logo tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Key-caps, cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The dashboard, section panels and the film frame.

tokens.name: radius-phone
tokens.usage: Frosted phone shell (its screen uses 34px).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, labels, slots and the nav bar.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App-icon corner (iOS-style), as a share of the icon width.

shadow.note: One scale. To lift, move the element up and fade in the next step on a layer; never animate box-shadow itself.

tokens.name: sh-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards, chips, the nav and list rows.

tokens.name: sh-2
tokens.usage: Floating objects, primary buttons, the sticky note.

tokens.name: sh-3
tokens.usage: Lifted: hovered keys, phone shells, sheets and the dashboard.

tokens.name: sh-key
tokens.usage: Key-cap at rest: top highlight, the 3D key side and sh-2.

tokens.name: sh-key-row
tokens.usage: Compact key rows inside a phone screen.

tokens.name: blur-frost
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur for the frosted nav, sheets and phone glass (with saturate 160%).

tokens.name: blur-glow
tokens.usage: Gradient glow behind the dashboard. Static; never over moving content.
